item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong process evidence for measurement in education, cash transfers, and public investment management.\nI did not find equally strong independent evidence of a government-wide service-delivery dashboard, routine publication of outcome indicators, or open complaint loops in health, housing, or social services.\nThe most convincing positives are technocratic and program-specific; the most convincing negatives show that when service failures became politically sensitive, correction was often delayed, rushed, or repressive rather than transparent.","evidence":[{"title":"Arab Republic of Egypt: Technical Assistance Report-Public Investment Management Assessment","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/02/arab-republic-of-egypt-technical-assistance-report-public-investment-management-assessment-547051","summary":"The report says Egypt had already taken steps to improve infrastructure access and public investment management through new legislation, information systems, and staff-capacity efforts, and it recommends stronger appraisal, selection, maintenance, procurement, portfolio management, transparent budget reporting, and e-procurement.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.4","5B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: Preparing Students for Life and the Workplace of Tomorrow","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-05-21","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2024/05/21/egypt-preparing-students-for-life-and-the-workplace-of-tomorrow","summary":"Education reform used explicit measurement and feedback: new exams, teacher training, quality assurance, digital learning resources, and two rounds of grade-4 assessment; the article also notes concrete implementation problems such as overcrowding, tutoring pressure, and a short school year.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.2"]},{"title":"Promoting Inclusive Human Capital Development and Building Resilience in Egypt through Cash Transfer Programs","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs","summary":"Takaful and Karama is described as having a targeted delivery system based on proxy means testing, a grievance mechanism, and a dynamic social registry; the ministry also produced case studies, videos, and a depository, which are strong signs of monitored and iterated social-policy delivery.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Under the patronage of President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, the Administrative Control Authority holds a launching ceremony for the third phase of the National Anti-Corruption Strategy 2023-2030","publisher":"Administrative Control Authority","date":"2024","url":"https://aca.gov.eg/News/3173.aspx","summary":"The launch framed the new phase around transparency, integrity, anti-corruption frameworks, and improving public services, but this is framework-level signaling rather than proof of service outcomes.","question_ids":["6B.5","5B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: New law threatens to reduce access to healthcare for millions","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-new-law-threatens-to-reduce-access-to-healthcare-for-millions/","summary":"Sisi ratified Law 87 of 2024 without adequate consultation; the law lets private actors run public health facilities for profit without price regulation, which is the opposite of transparent corrective stewardship.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.2","6B.4"]},{"title":"Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"Refugee children were kept out of school by residency requirements, fees, and discrimination; that shows weak correction and poor feedback from service failure, especially for a vulnerable population.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: President al-Sisi must reject new asylum law which violates refugee rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-03","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/egypt-president-al-sisi-must-reject-new-asylum-law-which-violates-refugee-rights/","summary":"The asylum law was rushed, lacked meaningful consultation, broadened discretionary power, and failed to protect education, housing, and social-security rights; that is strong negative evidence on transparent correction.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt Crackdown on People Voicing Concerns Over Economic Crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"When people criticized prices, living conditions, and service failures, authorities responded with arrests and abuse rather than open correction, which weakens the case for evidence-based service improvement.","question_ids":["6B.5","5B.7"]}]}
